name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx web server with multi-site virtual host management, SSL termination using self-signed certificates, and security hardening via UFW, fail2ban, and sysctl tuning.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures a dual caching layer with Memcached and Redis (with password authentication), including a post-install patch to remove deprecated Redis config directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI Python application by cloning from GitHub, setting up a Python virtual environment, provisioning a PostgreSQL database, and registering the application as a systemd service.
